Nina (Partnerships): Quick ask  Cryptex Labs (HSM + KMS) wants a lightweight marketplace connector that includes SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and a secrets-sync shim. Need technical owners + launch cadence.
Omar (Security Eng): I'll handle attestation + PKCS#11 compatibility. Request their FIPS certs and attestation evidence. Also need their failure-mode behavior if the HSM is unreachable.
Jules (Product): Let's list as 'partner-hosted HSM' with an option for Redwood-assisted onboarding. Need SKU and support matrix.
Cam (Solutions): For SI installs, I'll draft SCIM->role mappings and SAML attribute guidance. Also propose a one-click toggle in the marketplace docs for "Enable secrets-sync" with networking notes.
Rina (Legal): Flagging indemnity and data residency. If keys can be exported we need explicit customer opt-in and contract language. Ask for SOC2 / compliance docs.
marketplace-bot: Created ticket partners/cryptex-kms-onboard (#2710).
Nina (Partnerships): Timeline: this week gather evidence & mapping; next week dev connector; week after closed beta. Can we aim for a short co-hosted webinar month after beta?
Omar (Security Eng): Action items: get attestation artefacts, confirm encrypt/decrypt API surface, and prepare log-redaction test.
Jules (Product): I'll mock listing copy and billing flow. Cam/Rina/Nina let's meet Thursday 11am PT to align.
Cam (Solutions): On the call I'll bring an SI runbook draft (SSO->SCIM->sync->rotation & failover test).
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks all  drop anything else here before Thursday. :thumbsup:
